powers-of-x.alt: For x greater than 0, three curves through the point (1, 1): y = x squared rising steeply, y = x to the one-half (the square root of x) rising slowly, and y = x to the negative one (1 over x) falling toward the x-axis.

exponent-ladder.alt: A column of powers of 2: 2 to the 3 = 8, 2 to the 2 = 4, 2 to the 1 = 2, 2 to the 0 = 1, 2 to the negative 1 = 1/2, 2 to the negative 2 = 1/4, 2 to the negative 3 = 1/8. An arrow marked divide by 2 leads from each one to the next: lowering the exponent by 1 halves the value, so negative exponents give small positive fractions.
